image_description: A large, brown sea lion resting on a concrete dock or pier edge next to water. The animal is lying prone with its head resting near the edge of the platform. Its body is streamlined and fusiform, covered in short, coarse-looking fur that appears wet or sleek. The head shows visible external ear flaps and whiskers. The foreflippers are tucked under or alongside the body, not fully extended for walking. The background includes the textured concrete surface and dark water.

checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Small, distinct external ear flaps are clearly visible on the side of the head, confirming it is a sea lion (otariid) and not a true seal (phocid).
Long, light-colored whiskers are clearly visible extending from the snout area.
